title: AgentReady Lab source ledger v0
description: The independent, versioned record of every pinned source. Every source_refs identifier in specs/checks.v0.yaml and specs/ruleset.standard.v0.yaml resolves against this file and against nothing else (ADR-0008 section 1). Most entries are external; a `project-policy` entry is this project's own policy, admitted by ADR-0010 section 1 and labelled so that it can never be read as someone else's specification.

source_ledger_version.description: Moves when a source's version, status, verification date, or recorded state changes, independently of the snapshot and of the ruleset.

ledger_date.description: The ledger's own declared clock: the date this revision of the ledger was current. No verified_at may be after it, and it may not be earlier than the newest verified_at. It is the ceiling for ledger dates in place of snapshot.captured_at, because ADR-0008 section 1 versions the ledger independently of the snapshot.

todo.description: Values an accepted decision requires but does not supply. Never a placeholder for a value that was simply not looked up.

allOf.description: ADR-0010 section 1. A self-authored source has no published URL and an external source has no repository path, so exactly one of the two locators is present and which one it is follows from `kind`. Fabricating an https URL for this project's own policy is the specific thing this branch exists to make impossible.

url.description: The published location of an external source. Forbidden on a project-policy source: this project publishes no URL for its own policy, and an https link beside a self-authored entry is provenance a reader would take for someone else's.

document.description: ADR-0010 section 1. The repository-relative path holding a self-authored source's text. Present only on a project-policy source, and never beside a `url`.

version.description: Exact version, dated draft, release, RFC number, or immutable commit. An undated mutable URL is not provenance on its own.
